Beta blockers Beta blockers are competitive antagonists at beta-adrener- gic receptor sites and are used in the management of cardi- ovascular disorders such as hypertension, angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmias, myocardial infarction, and heart fail- ure. They are also given to control symptoms of sympa- thetic overactivity in alcohol withdrawal, anxiety states, hyperthyroidism, and tremor and in the prophylaxis of mi- graine and of bleeding associated with portal hypertension. Their actions and uses are discussed in more detail on p.1225. Beta blockers used mainly as eye drops to reduce raised intra-ocular pressure in glaucoma and ocular hypertension are discussed under Miotics, Mydriatics, and Antiglauco- ma Drugs, p.1873.
